$header_note: QPB v1.5.7 longer-Windows bug-hunting plan — 4-run claude+copilot+codex matrix on Windows. Validates: (a) v1.5.7 174 manifest-based pool model on Windows, (b) 178+179 SKILL.md mandates on opus (first opus test post-179 — round-1 Mac tokio failed exactly because of the mandates 179 now enforces), (c) codex Mode B on Windows (first end-to-end Windows codex test post-156 install-target fix; akka was deferred from Mac round-2 due to codex quota), (d) bug-finding capacity across 4 ecosystems. Branch refs confirmed via git ls-remote: tokio=master, webpack=main, Newtonsoft.Json=master, akka=main. Concurrency: pool={claude:1, copilot:2, codex:1} — all 4 run in parallel; ~60-80 min wall clock bounded by claude/opus on tokio or codex Mode B on akka. Pre-flight: on Windows, ensure (a) git, (b) python 3.10+, (c) node + npm for the npm-local-tgz row, (d) the QPB clone is at branch 1.5.7 HEAD, (e) the claude / copilot / codex CLIs are installed + authenticated, (f) codex CLI specifically — if it fails on Windows, the akka row will ABORTED_PHASE early but the other 3 are independent.

runs.description: Row 0 — claude/opus reviews tokio (Rust async runtime, ref=master) via pip-local-wheel (Mode A). Same row as Mac plan row 0. Tests pip-local-wheel install on Windows + cross-platform tokio review.

Row 1 — copilot/gpt-5.4 reviews webpack (JavaScript module bundler, ref=main) via npm-local-tgz (Mode A). Same row as Mac plan row 1. Tests the npm-local-tgz (npx --yes --prefer-offline) install path on Windows; this is the install path most likely to surface Windows-specific issues if any remain.

Row 2 — copilot/gpt-5.4 reviews Newtonsoft.Json (C# JSON serializer, ref=master) via pip-local-wheel (Mode A). Same row as Mac plan row 2. C# repo on Windows is a natural fit; tests pip-local-wheel on Windows + a Mode A run on a non-main ref via the post-177 BUG-010 fix path.

Row 3 — codex/gpt-5.4 reviews akka (Scala/Java actors, ref=main) via clone channel (Mode B). codex requires Mode B (single-turn exec). akka was deferred from Mac round-2 (harness_runs/20260601T032323Z) when codex hit a vendor usage limit at 4s; the bundle into this Windows run amortizes the akka attempt against the Windows codex-Mode-B validation. akka's actor model + supervision hierarchy is concurrency-heavy in the same family as sidekiq's job-queue surface that produced 10 verified bugs.
